title: Tor amplitude on an open implies universal tensor exactness of principal localizations
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, let P be a bounded-above cochain complex of finite free A-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let U be a quasi-compact open of Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose the derived restriction to U of the termwise associated-sheaf complex of P has Tor amplitude in [a,b], expressed by [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes]. For every f in A with D(f) contained in U and every A_f-module N, the termwise tensor complex P_f tensor N is exact in every integer degree i<a. Here P_f is the canonical localized complex defined by Mathlib ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor at powers f.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 36.13.6, lower truncation paragraph; Tags 09U8 and 08E9 for restriction and affine tensor computation

proof.text: Apply principal_localization_sheaf_tor_bounds to f with D(f) contained in U. This produces sheaf Tor bounds for tilde of the concrete localized complex Q on Spec(A_f), without needing boundedness or finiteness. Widen the upper endpoint to max(a,b). Apply affine_torAmplitude_iff, using a <= max(a,b), to get module Tor amplitude of Q in [a,max(a,b)].

Exact localization sends zero terms to zero terms, so Q is bounded above with the same upper bound as P. Free terms of P are flat, and Module.Flat.of_isLocalizedModule makes each term of Q flat. The bounded-above flat acyclicity theorem implies that the homotopy quotient of Q tensors every acyclic object to an acyclic object on the right. Braiding gives the left tensor statement. The K-flat acyclicity characterization and quotient K-flat equivalence therefore make Q categorically K-flat.

Test module Tor amplitude against N, keeping its IsGE a component. The proved source isomorphism DerivedCategory.QObjTensorSingleFunctorObjIso for K-flat Q identifies this tensor with Q of the termwise tensorRight N complex. Transport IsGE along that isomorphism; DerivedCategory.isGE_Q_obj_iff returns IsGE a of the ordinary complex. CochainComplex.isGE_iff yields ExactAt i for every i<a.
